reason: V3-06 repair. The audit found the four must-fix findings from the previous cycle remain unresolved: (1) cursor advance and materialization are not in a single transaction — pullDeltas calls applyDeltas then setCursor as sequential top-level statements, and the in-memory withTransaction still snapshots only contributionRepo and todoRepo, not all affected repos, so a mid-transaction failure leaves partial writes; (2) when a local dirty record wins a conflict (local revision higher than remote), storeLocalRecords overwrites the buffer with the remote record, silently losing the local offline edit from the push queue; (3) ScopedRepositoryFacade membership enforcement is imported only by the test file — AppContext.tsx and screens use unscoped repos directly, so no membership verification happens for product reads/writes; (4) no test exercises the SQLite repository path for the sync pipeline — all sync tests run only against createInMemoryRepositories(). The WIP baseline from the previous cycle must be preserved and the next cycle must repair these findings on the existing candidate.
